zpnbc7: Original SpanishCue text. Read to understand the experience and the decision; then go back to the details.
3j9kvu: Tomorrow Clara leaves the city to work for six months at a cultural center. Her friends organized a simple farewell: each person brought a card with a wish and a possible kind of help. They didn't want to give her a list of advice nobody had asked for. They wanted her to take something useful with her and to know whom to call if she needed company.
4lvvf0: The first card said: «Espero que encuentres gente con la que puedas compartir tus ideas. Si quieres, el domingo podemos hablar por videollamada». Another friend wrote: «Que disfrutes del trabajo, pero también de los ratos libres. Te mando el contacto de una asociación que organiza paseos». Clara especially appreciated the messages that acknowledged her nerves. She was excited about traveling, though she was also worried about not knowing anyone. Hearing only “I'm sure it will be perfect” didn't help her as much as being able to talk about her doubts.
p4p7lt: For Clara it was a great opportunity, though she didn't expect every day to be fantastic. She said she was just as excited as she was nervous and that one bad day would not define the whole experience.
2rkjey: At the end of the dinner, Clara read her own card to the group. She hoped they would keep meeting and tell her even the small news. She didn't want to receive only photos of big celebrations. «Ojalá sigamos compartiendo las cosas normales», she said. Before leaving they agreed on a first call, but without turning it into a weekly obligation. The farewell did not remove the sadness; it turned it into a beginning they could accompany.
